messages.author: 6ecf433d477085ba
messages.subject: ggplot geom_bar stack (position adjustment)
parts:
Dear List,

I am a new user. The issue is that I am getting an incorrect percent
distribution (y) with respect to the fill () factor for each level of
x() - ggplot geom_bar.

Below are the data and code. I would appreciate receiving your help.

Thanks in advance.

Pradip Muhuri

#Goal: To plot stacked barplots showing the percentages of (1)
divorced/separated, (2) married, (3) never married
#in each of the seven races (seven bars) such that each bar normalizes
to height 1.

# Below are the data used in the creation of the data frame, ignoring
the first and last columns
# Div/Sep Married Never_Mar Total
#White 1 19.55 59.40 21.05 100%
#Black 2 24.76 35.02 40.22 100%
#AI/AN 3 22.96 46.00 31.04 100%
#HI/PI 4 10.88 56.79 32.33 100%
#Asian 5 10.10 62.73 27.17 100%
#Multi Race 6 15.70 53.14 31.16 100%
#Hispanic 7 25.22 45.24 29.54 100%

setwd ("F:/Disorders")
library (ggplot2)
Race= rep(c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7), each=3)
MStatus = rep(c(1,2,3), each=7)
Percentage = c(19.55,59.40,21.05,
24.76,35.02,40.22,
22.96,46.00,31.04,
10.88,56.79,32.33,
10.10,62.73,27.17,
15.70,53.14,31.16,
25.22,45.24,29.54)

dat = data.frame(Race, MStatus, Percentage)
dat$Race <- factor(dat$Race,levels=c (5,2,4,7,1,6,3),
labels=c("Asian","Black","Hawiian/
OPI","Hispanic","White","Multi Race","AI/AN"))
dat$MStatus <- factor(dat$MStatus, levels=c (2, 3,
1),labels=c("Married","Never Married","Div/Wid/Sep"))

p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=Race, y=Percentage, fill=MStatus))+
geom_bar(stat="identity")+
xlab (" ") +
opts(legend.position="right",
panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),
panel.grid.minor=theme_blank(),
title="Marital Status by Race/Ethnicity",
axis.text.y=theme_text(size=11, face="bold"),
axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=12,
face="bold"),
panel.background=theme_rect(),
plot.title = theme_text(size=15, face="bold")
)
print (p)
ggsave(file="mstatus.pdf"", width=7, height=7)
dev off ()

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: ggplot geom_bar stack (position adjustment)
parts:
I think your data is wrong. The rep call is wrong. There should be one combination of race/status to use  stat_identity. Given the data you post in table format I figure that 
MStatus = rep(c(1,2,3), each=7) 
should be:
MStatus = rep(c(1,2,3), 7)
Changing that yields a sensible graphic.

HTH
Luciano


2011/8/18 pradip...@samhsa.hhs.gov <pradip...@samhsa.hhs.gov>
